mission.name: The Long Siege (Orc 3/3)
mission.briefing: The humans besiege your stronghold in three waves. Endure, then break their keep with ogres and dragons alike.
mission.objective: Survive the siege, then destroy the human keep.

ops.text: Necrolyte: hold the walls until the moon is high, then we descend.
Survive the siege, then destroy the human keep.
Your keep has fallen. The campaign is lost.
The enemy is wiped from these lands. Victory!
